content: I will outline how I reached M5, please note this is not the minimum requirements but it serves to give you a goalpost to aim for that can garuntee an easy unlock. ** You don't need fractal (nothing hour) sneaking upgrade to reach M5**
This is my toon setup and inventory with gcharm levels
Here you can see my upgrade levels and gem count and percentages
This is my final stealth total (I had 100% detection chance) and I had e50 damage
**As for buffs outside of sneaking:**

Moon of Sneak lvl 250 (WW Compass Upgrade)

Farming level 466 with R11 landrank for seed of stealth

Hole schematic with 13 QQ quavers

Stealth Chapter bubble at 98% effectiveness or level 2655, with 30k tome score (Green bubble 30 last w6 one)

Hinge Buster Bubble 95% or lvl 1335 (Yellow bubble 28)

All my WW talents at 451 for sneaking

Additional Lesser Buffs:

205 Crop Depot giving 4600% jade joins (Farming)

4.9x stealth multi from emperor 60 (W6 boss)

And lastly please remember:


** You don't need fractal (nothing hour) sneaking upgrade to reach M5**

I am pretty sure you're way too overprepared, I pushed with much less stats and still cleared it under a month <:Grumblo_Pray:1114306970816630876> e31 stealth and a nunchuk that can 1 shot the last door (1290+ m4f6 chuk) is all you need

I started my grind yesterday at about 5e31 across three pushers, who each could one shot the door (1300ish m4f6 chuks).  I was expecting this to take weeks, and would gradually improve stealth through emperor battles, farming levels, and statue levels, but ~36 hours was all it took.
I have no idea how lucky I was, or if I even was lucky.

Yeah the odds seem very favourable to us a 1 in 1000 chance which would display as 100% detection, would take on average 2000 mins, which is 33 hours, if you had slower or faster action speed and depending on your respawn time etc, this can double or 4x. So yeah you got pretty lucky but it seems like we all get carried in sneaking xD
